body:
S&P 500 shows strong development within a rising trend channel in the medium long term. Rising trends indicate that the market experiences positive development and that buy interest among investors is increasing. It also gave positive signal from the rectangle formation at the break up through the resistance at 7594. Further rise to 7833 or more is signaled. The index has broken up through resistance at points 7570. This predicts a further rise. The index is overall assessed as technically [...] as technically positive for the medium long term.
